description: This file appears to be a performance testing script for the JMESPath PHP implementation. It loads dependencies, verifies directory existence, warms up the environment, and runs performance benchmarks on JSON data files by executing various test cases.

classes.name: JmesPath\\Env
classes.description: A helper class for interacting with the JMESPath runtime environment, including methods for creating runtime instances and executing searches.

classes.name: Composer\XdebugHandler\XdebugHandler
classes.description: A class used to manage Xdebug-related configurations during script execution.

methods.name: runSuite
methods.description: Runs a performance test suite by executing multiple JSON-defined test cases and summing their execution times.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Performs a single test case execution multiple times, measuring the shortest runtime, and handles cache management.
